purpose: User-requested fixed top-five versus top-ten allocation test using existing after-hours plus premarket forecasts
individual_accounts: All ten saved AH+PM individual-seed forecasts at five and ten holdings, base fees
primary_question: For the original-five AH+PM rank ensemble, does changing only target holding count from ten to five improve net historical performance?
diagnostics: Fixed ten-seed/new-five ensembles, matched daily-only controls, all ten individual seeds, fee stress, annual and monthly returns. No new feature, checkpoint, seed, holding count or exposure tuning.
execution: Identical 09:15 Eastern feature cutoff, 09:20 entry-day decision and same entry-day regular-close fill, with shares sized from the known preceding close. Equal long-only targets, five-session rebalance, continuous $1m account, existing 1% ADV share limits, fees, cancellations and corporate-action accounting. No extended-hours fills.
source_checks: Verify completed parent source/data/checkpoint locks and published hashes, reconstruct rank ensembles from saved predictions, reproduce every matching prior top-ten account and original daily top-five reference.
confidence: 10000 paired circular-block replicates at 5/20/60 sessions, 20 primary. Absolute Sharpe intervals and paired CAGR/Sharpe/annual-arithmetic-active-return differences. One fixed 12-contrast family: each AH+PM group's top-five versus its top-ten, SPY, QQQ and matched daily-only top-five. Simultaneous diagnostics cover these twelve, not the earlier research search.
stop_rule: Freeze protocol, source and saved forecast inputs before computing the new top-five test returns. Independently replay all 62 accounts and publish every declared group, seed, cost and negative result.
history: 2022-2025 is previously inspected exploratory development. The original-five subgroup is requested explicitly; it is not an unseen confirmation. No deployment, trades or recurring jobs.
